text:
Tanya: @channel quick reminder — we're planning the branch cut for release/1.8 today at 17:00 PT. Please finish any change that must go in this release and open PRs against main with the label `needs-release` by 16:00 PT so we can evaluate.

Kevin: Got it. Is the version bump handled automatically or should the release PR include package version + changelog?

Tanya: We prefer the release PR to include the version bump and a CHANGELOG entry. Release tooling still expects a single release PR that does the final cut and tag. If you want, add a one-line note under Unreleased -> 1.8 in CHANGELOG.md.

Omar: Quick Q on backports — rules? Do we backport only bugfixes or also small feature flags?

Tanya: Backports to release/1.8 are only for bugfixes and anything that fixes regressions or critical perf issues. Feature flags or user-facing features get deferred to next minor unless explicitly approved by PM. Use label `backport-1.8` on PRs you want considered.

Ravi: For anyone doing cherry-picks, please add the original PR link and use `git cherry-pick -x` so commit message includes original. Also mention the backport PR in the original PR comment.

Jen: Example commands I'm using:
```
# start from main remote
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/1.8 origin/main
# cherry-pick one commit
git cherry-pick -x <commit-sha>
# resolve conflicts, then
git commit
git push origin release/1.8
```

Omar: tagging in case of conflict resolution help — @Kevin can you help with the db migration cherry-pick if it collides?

Kevin: Yup, I'll be available around 15:30 PT to help. If you hit conflicts, push the branch with WIP and ping me, I'll take a look.

release-bot: created branch release/1.8 from origin/main at sha 0abc1234 — automated snapshot created.

Tanya: Heads up — cutoff for anything that needs QA by the release team is 16:00 PT. After that we only accept critical backports with explicit approval from @Tanya and QA sign-off.

Ravi: I have a small fix (PR #572) that needs backport. Opening PR against main now and will add `backport-1.8` label.

Jen: Done with cherry-pick for PR #558 — pushed release/1.8 branch. CI is running but I saw one flaky test locally, will watch.

ci-bot: build started for branch release/1.8 (job #4821).

Omar: Ran into a conflict on the migration commit, message: "error: could not apply 9d4f6...". I tried to resolve but unsure about the new index API changes. Pushed my WIP to release/1.8-wip and @Kevin for help.

Kevin: Looking now. If we need to tweak the migration, prefer small change that preserves compatibility. Will propose a patch and we can run upgrade tests.

Tanya: If anyone opens a cherry-pick PR directly against release/1.8, please prefix the title with "[BACKPORT 1.8]" and include the original PR number in body. That helps release notes automation.

Ravi: FYI I added a changelog line: "Fix memory leak in tokenizer — backported from #572" and bumped package.json patch. Can someone confirm that's fine for the release PR?

Kevin: Looks fine. I approved the backport PR.

Jen: CI passed for my cherry-pick except one timeout on e2e. Re-running.

ci-bot: build passed for branch release/1.8 (job #4821). e2e job requeued.

Tanya: Great progress — plan to open the main release PR at 16:15 PT to gather final checks, then cut the tag at 17:00 PT. Anyone blocked, ping now.

Omar: Not blocked anymore — thanks @Kevin.

Kevin: Resolved migration conflict, pushed fix to release/1.8. Ran local migrations and smoke tests.

Jen: Re-ran e2e, passed. Pushing final tweak to changelog.

Tanya: Thanks everyone. After the cut, please don't merge non-backport PRs into release/1.8. For post-release hotfixes follow the same backport workflow.

release-bot: reminder — release checklist: update CHANGELOG.md, bump version, create release PR, run release smoke tests, tag and publish.

Ravi: All set from my side. Good luck! :rocket:

Kevin: On standby for the tag.

Tanya: Tagging wrap — will post final release PR link once created. :slightly_smiling_face:
